definition_one_sentence: Account with at least one non-cancelled order in the 12 months before the report date.
formula_or_rule: count(distinct customer_id) where order_date > report_date - 12 months and order_date <= report_date and status <> 'cancelled'
example: On 2026-11-25: account 10328, last order 2026-07-17 (delivered), is active. 1080 active customers (the Sales rule gave 811).
notes_conflicts: Counted per account, not per person: 52 emails are shared by several customer_id. 12 months chosen for the board (year to year). The Sales 6 months view is the term recently active customer. last_order_date includes cancelled orders.

definition_one_sentence: Account with at least one non-cancelled order in the 6 months before the report date.
formula_or_rule: count(distinct customer_id) where order_date > report_date - 6 months and order_date <= report_date and status <> 'cancelled'
example: On 2026-11-25: account 10328 (last order 2026-07-17) is recently active. 775 accounts, all also active customers.
notes_conflicts: For the Sales dashboard and campaigns (seasonal collections). Do not call it active customer.

definition_one_sentence: What ShopFast keeps on an order after refunds, without VAT, shipping included.
formula_or_rule: round((gross_revenue_eur - refunded_eur) / 1.20, 2) per order, summed on the period
example: Order 700236: 424.50 paid, no refund = 353.75. Order 700063: 131.52 paid and refunded = 0. October 2026: 43857.16 EUR.
notes_conflicts: Sales wanted VAT included for commissions: that is gross_revenue_eur - refunded_eur (52628.43 EUR in October 2026), not net revenue. Flat 20% VAT assumed.

definition_one_sentence: Account that already had a non-cancelled order but none in the 12 months before the report date.
formula_or_rule: last non-cancelled order_date <= report_date - 12 months; accounts with no order are left out
example: On 2026-11-25: account 10017, last order 2025-10-16, is churned. 145 accounts.
notes_conflicts: Opposite of active customer, no overlap. Target of the churn model.

definition_one_sentence: Account registered on ShopFast with one customer_id, with or without orders.
example: 1241 raw rows - 8 duplicates = 1233 accounts, 15 never ordered.
notes_conflicts: One person can have several accounts (52 shared emails). Personal data, confidential.

definition_one_sentence: Purchase made by an account on one date and one channel, with one order_id, whatever the status.
formula_or_rule: count(distinct order_id) from stg_orders; status in pending, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned
example: 5207 raw rows - 7 duplicates = 5200 orders, 434 cancelled. Order 700236 of account 10328 on 2025-06-18: 424.50 EUR, delivered.
notes_conflicts: A cancelled order is still an order but does not make a customer active. 11 orders have no date.
